defects.description: Five mobile states have a 5.23 px title/subtitle collision because wrapped 28 px titles extend beyond their 61 px text boxes: event setup validation, registration empty, organizer empty audience, organizer low coverage, and recommendation unavailable.

Critical privacy, warning, failure, coverage, and screening-rights copy is set at 9-10 px across the desktop and mobile boards, making essential guidance and safeguards too small for a customer-facing responsive interface.
The 9 px wine flow labels use #8A3046 on #151213 or #181415 backgrounds (approximately 2.25-2.30:1 contrast), so the state labels do not meet the approved high-contrast direction.

Neither responsive board contains an image fill; the final-selection state uses an abstract poster placeholder, so the approved strong-film-imagery direction is not carried into the selected-film outcome.
